newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak crown steady at NBS fix, pressure expected.
newsitem.headline: Slovak crown steady at NBS fix, pressure expected.

text.p: 1040 GMT - The Slovak crown held steady at around the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) fixing in the first hour of afternoon trade, but dealers said it might weaken later in the day.
*Slovak crown at around 65 basis points in its depreciation sphere after the NBS fixed it at -0.63 percent versus the mark/dollar basket parity at 0940 GMT.

*"There is fear on the market that the crown will weaken but its hard to say to what levels it should move. It will, to a large extent, follow the Czech crown movements later today, said one Bratislava-based foreign bank trader.
*NBS Friday fixing, crown/dollar 33.226, crown/mark 19.568, deviation against the midpoint -0.63 percent. At the time of the index calculation the crown was trading at -0.61 percent.
